title: Falling Concrete
statement: A road has n sections with heights a_i (n ≤ a_i ≤ 10^9, n up to 2·10^5). One operation takes section j, moves it back to position i<j, lowering it by j−i while every section it passes over rises by 1. The task is to find the maximum possible length of a contiguous segment of equal heights after any number of operations.
